choices.why: Its deep teal-green tufted upholstery and slim profile come closest to the dark green velvet sofa requested, and it sits well facing the fireplace.
A classic deep armchair with turned black legs and dark charcoal fabric that echoes the dark mantel, ideal as a facing pair.
A large ornate traditional rug in soft grays, big enough for the whole seating group and in tune with the pale blue-green walls.
A dark-wood tray-top table on a dark frame, with a moderate size that suits the space between the sofa and the fireplace.
A large horizontal mirror with a dark wood frame, the right proportion to center on the chimney breast above the dark mantel.
An elegant floor lamp with a drum shade and polished-metal base that adds a classic, refined accent beside an armchair.

answer.why: Dark green, charcoal and dark wood repeat the tone of the mantel against the pale walls, and the gray traditional rug ties the classic seating group together around the fireplace.
